Decide whether the proposal deck addresses the client requirement below.

STATUS (choose exactly one):
- "Covered": the slides commit to ALL parts of the requirement. Different wording is fine.
- "Partially covered": the slides commit to SOME parts, but at least one part is missing.
- "Not covered":

response.missing: Benchmarking network operational performance against a minimum of five peer-level international hospital groups.
response.reasoning: While slide 15 mentions a proprietary database covering 200+ hospitals globally, the proposal slides never commit to performing a specific benchmark against a minimum of five peer-level international hospital groups as requested.
